en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a tree-lined promenade with wooden pavilions or kiosks on both sides, likely in a spa or resort park. Several well‑dressed women in long dresses and hats walk along the path, while men stand near the shopfronts. A sign hangs above one shop entrance reading "Josef Staab," and there is a large German text poster on the left building. The number "1328" and the word beneath it, which looks like a place name, are handwritten along the bottom edge of the image.
